remarks: Beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath unit with a loft at "Eastside Commons". This beautiful corner unit features impressive 9+ foot ceilings, abundant natural light, & a thoughtfully refreshed interior that blends style and comfort. Recent upgrades include new carpeting in all bedrooms & the loft, new composite flooring throughout the main living areas, fresh paint throughout, updated lighting & vanity bath fixtures, & new kitchen appliances, making this home truly move-in ready. The spacious layout welcomes you w/open-concept design ideal for both everyday living & entertaining. All 3 bedrooms overlook the courtyard, including the primary suite, complete with an en suite bath & a large custom walk-in closet. Ceiling fans in every bedroom, the living room, and the loft provide year-round comfort. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, & an island that offers storage while doubling as a convenient breakfast bar. Overlooking the living room & private balcony, the versatile loft, complete with a bonus storage room, creates an airy, open feel and offers flexible space for a home office, lounge, or creative studio. Residents enjoy access to outstanding amenities, including a fully equipped fitness center, a beautifully landscaped courtyard with gas grills and seating areas, and garage parking with two elevators for added convenience. Short distance from I-95, downtown, and the train.
